latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the code-documenter skill.

- Provides documentation support for docstrings, API specs (OpenAPI/Swagger), documentation sites, and developer guides.
- Includes a senior technical writer role definition and detailed workflow from discovery to coverage reporting.
- Supports multiple frameworks and languages, with references for specific docstring and API documentation styles.
- Enforces best practices: asks for format, detects framework, covers errors, and generates coverage reports.
- Outputs include code documentation, API specs, site configs, and structured guides/tutorials.
- MIT licensed and related to skills like spec-miner, fullstack-guardian, and code-reviewer.
